description: Ed25519 public keys used to sign the records of the Arcaeon witness case protocol (arcaeon-case/1): sealed cases, withdrawal records and reference rows. Each signed record names its key in signed_by, the key id <key name>+<8 hex>; find that key id here and check the record's signature with the verifier string beside it. The signature is Ed25519 over the json-c14n:v1 bytes of the whole record minus sig. This key is never the witness log's key or the reconcile receipt's key.
matching: Match on key_id, then use verifier: <key name>+<8 lowercase hex of sha256(name || 0x0a || 0x01 || public key)[0:4]>+<base64(0x01 || 32-byte Ed25519 public key)>, the signed-note verifier format of the witness log. key_id is the verifier without its base64 tail. Compare key bytes, not names.

status_meaning.retired: rotated out; cases it signed while current remain trusted
status_meaning.revoked: withdrawn; do not trust cases signed by this key

rotation: Rotation adds a new key with status active and moves the previous key to retired, so records signed before the rotation keep verifying. A key is marked revoked only if its private half is believed exposed. This document is the single place either change is announced. The service signs only with a key listed here as active (it carries this document in its own deployment and checks the configured key against it); a configured key that is not listed is not used. No case-signing key has been provisioned yet: until a key is listed here, every case record carries sig null with its sig_reason (key_unpublished).
